EchoLingo 0.4.1 修复 PDF／图片视觉笔记在第 1 页立即失败的问题。
EchoLingo 0.4.1 fixes visual PDF/image notes failing immediately at page 1.

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english)

## 中文

- 修复 0.4.0 的视觉请求参数错误：勾选视觉阅读并使用 DeepSeek Flash 等模型时，程序会在发送图片前报错，显示“Visual reading failed at page 1”。页面读取、视觉能力探测和裁图检查三处调用现已修复。
- 增加使用真实客户端、仅模拟网络的回归测试；安装包自检也会离线执行视觉探测、PDF 页面读取和裁图检查，防止同类接口问题再次漏检。
- 更新后在 **History → Create notes** 重新添加课件，勾选 **Allow sending PDF pages and images**，再次生成即可。重试旧版或更换模型无法绕过此缺陷。

### 安装与限制

- macOS Apple Silicon（14+）：`EchoLingo_0.4.1_aarch64.dmg`；Windows x64：`EchoLingo_0.4.1_x64-setup.exe`；Linux x64：`EchoLingo_0.4.1_amd64.deb`。已有版本可在 **Settings → General → Updates** 检查更新；Linux 提供下载链接。
- Windows/Linux GPU 加速包必须匹配应用版本；更新后请在 **Settings → Models** 下载 0.4.1 加速包。
- 图片上传仍需单独授权。真实 DeepSeek 课件的手写识别、裁图质量及插入位置人工验收仍待完成；本修复不等同于质量验收。
- macOS 仍为临时签名、未经 Apple 公证；Windows 安装程序未做代码签名。首次安装指引见 [使用说明](https://github.com/Asphr726/EchoLingo#readme)。

## English

- Fixes an invalid visual request argument introduced in 0.4.0. Visual reading with DeepSeek Flash and other models could fail before sending any images, displaying “Visual reading failed at page 1.” Page reading, capability probing and crop verification calls are corrected.
- Adds regression coverage using the real client with only the HTTP transport mocked. Packaged runtime self-tests now exercise the visual probe, PDF page reading and crop check offline to detect these integration errors.
- After updating, reopen **History → Create notes**, attach the course materials, check **Allow sending PDF pages and images**, and generate again. Retrying or changing models in 0.4.0 does not bypass the defect.

### Install and limitations

- macOS Apple Silicon (14+): `EchoLingo_0.4.1_aarch64.dmg`; Windows x64: `EchoLingo_0.4.1_x64-setup.exe`; Linux x64: `EchoLingo_0.4.1_amd64.deb`. Existing installations can check **Settings → General → Updates**; Linux links to the download.
- Windows/Linux GPU packs must match the application version. Download the 0.4.1 pack in **Settings → Models** after updating.
- Image uploads still require separate consent. Real DeepSeek course-material validation of handwriting, crop quality and insertion placement remains pending; this fix does not claim that quality gate has passed.
- The Mac build remains ad-hoc signed and not notarized; Windows is not code-signed. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/Asphr726/EchoLingo/blob/main/README.en.md).
